🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, a mixed/rotation backdrop; confirmation comes from fear rising and stocks lagging bonds. VXX (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%) ABOVE TREND, while SPY/TLT (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -10.10%) and HYG/LQD (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%) are both ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is increasing: VXX (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND. Credit stress is rising as HYG/LQD (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND; SPY/TLT (1W: -2.46% | 1M: -10.10%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND, also signals bonds outperforming stocks.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength is ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.38%), while the yield curve is ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.02% | 1M: +4.50%). TLT (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +5.20%) is ABOVE TREND, consistent with relative support for duration.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Financials and Discretionary are holding up: XLF (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) and XLY (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +5.25%) are ABOVE TREND; Staples also show strength via XLP (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +7.98%) ABOVE TREND. Tech is weak: XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) BELOW TREND; with breadth at 6/11, style leans Value/Cyclicals over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are weak: SPY (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND. Europe is in CORRECTION via VGK (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +2.20%), while China shows relative strength with FXI (1W: +5.65% | 1M: +4.48%) ABOVE TREND; EEM (1W: -2.80% | 1M: -10.24%) remains BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation is weak: ARKK (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -13.86%) and IBIT (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -7.31%) are BELOW TREND. IWM (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -1.41%) is also BELOW TREND, with small caps lagging on both horizons.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Gold is recovering: GLD (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -1.61%) and SLV (1W: +5.09% | 1M: -12.31%) are both in RECOVERY. Copper is weak, with CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is under pressure: XLE (1W: -12.00% | 1M: -5.55%) and BNO (1W: -12.84% | 1M: -2.23%) are BELOW TREND. Natural gas is only a short-term bounce, with UNG (1W: +2.97% | 1M: -13.51%) in RECOVERY.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Core trends confirm weakness in equities and strength in duration: SPY (1W: -2.70% | 1M: -4.99%) and XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) are BELOW TREND, while TLT (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +5.20%) is ABOVE TREND. No major 1W/1M divergence across these core ETFs; sector dispersion remains notable, with XLF (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor defensive exposure and duration, with XLP (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +7.98%) and TLT (1W: +0.10% | 1M: +5.20%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to growth-sensitive QQQ (1W: -4.98% | 1M: -12.24%) BELOW TREND; style favors Value over Growth, but retain selectivity given mixed breadth.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If relative strength persists, monitor XLF (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +5.40%) and XLY (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +5.25%), both ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: If selling broadens, watch XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) BELOW TREND and XLE (1W: -12.00% | 1M: -5.55%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If the short-term rebound extends, monitor GLD (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -1.61%) in RECOVERY. BEARISH: If cyclical demand weakens further, watch CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor VIX at 21.9500 (1W: +13.97% | 1M: +29.19%), ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND; HYG/LQD at 0.7388 (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.03%), ↓ falling, BELOW TREND. XLK/XLF at 2.8821 (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -20.65%), ↓ falling, BELOW TREND, is a key growth-versus-value relative-strength gauge.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, indicating mixed/rotation breadth. Financials and Discretionary are showing relative strength, with Value leading Growth. Monitor rising fear in VXX (1W: +14.26% | 1M: +27.32%) ABOVE TREND and continued Tech weakness in XLK (1W: -8.23% | 1M: -16.71%) BELOW TREND.
